description: Highflame's AI security platform provides runtime guardrails for prompt injection, sensitive-information disclosure, content safety, and agentic tool safety, organized around the OWASP LLM Top 10. Evaluates content against your Highflame application policy via Shield. Learn more at https://docs.highflame.ai/

description.text: Your Highflame service key (hf_sk_...), exchanged automatically for a short-lived token.
Highflame Shield host. Targets POST /v1/shield/guard. Use api.highflame.ai (default, gateway-routed) or your self-hosted Highflame host.
Highflame application name for policy-scoped guardrails (required). See https://docs.highflame.ai/documentation/agent-control-fabric/guardrails-policies
OAuth token-exchange URL. Defaults to https://auth.highflame.ai/oauth2/token.
Evaluates content against the selected Highflame guardrail capabilities (OWASP LLM Top 10). Omit capabilities to apply every guardrail enabled in your Highflame application policy.

capabilities.description: OWASP-aligned guardrail capabilities to run. Empty applies all guardrails enabled in the application policy.
